tool_input.description: Run the backup toolkit test suite

tool_input.command:
t=$(mktemp -d); t=$(cd "$t" && pwd -P)
mkdir -p "$t/src"; echo a > "$t/src/a.txt"
for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000 20260104-000000 20260105-000000 20260106-000000; do
  BACKUP_STAMP=$s bash backup.sh --quiet --dest "$t/d" --name demo "$t/src" >/dev/null
done
echo "--- dry-run keep=4:"
bash rotate.sh --dry-run --keep=4 --dest "$t/d" --name demo
echo "--- real keep=4:"
bash rotate.sh -q --dest "$t/d" --name demo --keep 4
echo "--- sidecars left:"; ls "$t/d"
echo "--- help exits:"; bash rotate.sh -h >/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- unknown option:"; bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/d" --name demo --bogus 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- missing value:"; bash verify.sh --dest 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- missing dest dir:"; bash verify.sh --dest "$t/nope" 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
rm -rf "$t"

result:
The scratch file lives in `/tmp` (outside this repo's sandbox) — the deletion needs interactive approval, so I left it there; it self-cleaned its fixtures. Nothing in the repository is affected.

Done — I changed `lib/common.sh` (new: shared option parser + `resolve_dir`, now sourced by `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh`), `rotate.sh` (surplus is now the oldest `total-keep` archives via `head -n`, so `--keep N` keeps all N and rotation never touches the newest), `verify.sh` (sidecar name is taken as the whole rest of the line via `read`, so spaces in archive names verify `ok` with exit 0), and `tests/run_tests.sh` (added one test group for the rotate bug and one for the space-in-name verify bug; `bash tests/run_tests.sh` passes all 9 tests).
